title: SignalTerrain
lead: A calm observatory for invisible environments — radio situational awareness with private receivers, timelines, and maps. Home for Signal Intelligence Foundation V1 (architecture). Educational cyber awareness is planned later, not available yet.
mission: Help operators, listeners, and careful learners observe RF environments without noise, rumor, or surveillance culture — guide like a park ranger, not a SOC.
principles: Shared receivers are opt-in and privacy-aware
Never fabricate signals, incidents, or threat claims
Cyber tools, when built, stay educational — not an enterprise SOC

capabilityGroups.title: RF Intelligence
capabilityGroups.description: Radio and spectrum awareness: receivers, logging, timelines, and geographic context. Future RF topics may include SDR, NOAA, amateur radio, ADS-B, AIS, satellites, and spectrum monitoring — only when honestly available.

capabilityGroups.title: Cyber Intelligence
capabilityGroups.description: Planned educational situational awareness for individuals and homelabs (advisories, outages, vulnerability literacy). Not shipped. Not a security operations center.

modules.title: Receiver management
modules.description: Keep a private registry of receivers, locations, and capabilities.

modules.title: Incident timeline
modules.description: Structured events with confidence and clear source notes.

modules.title: Search
modules.description: Find incidents, audio, and transcripts in one place.

modules.title: Mapping
modules.description: See receivers and incidents in geographic context.

modules.title: Audio library
modules.description: Local audio with retention you control.

modules.title: Transcription
modules.description: Optional transcripts — labeled clearly when assisted.

modules.title: Extensions
modules.description: Room for receivers, parsers, and exporters without locking you in.

modules.title: Community receivers
modules.description: Opt-in shared receivers with anonymization options.

modules.title: Cyber awareness view
modules.description: Future educational digest of advisories and infrastructure incidents — documentation only until built.

dataModel: Receivers, incidents, and audio stay on your device first. Nothing syncs until you choose a path that earns trust. Planned cyber surfaces must not invent events.
